# Pinned metal advancement fixtures

These 54 JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/misc/common/materials

`sha256.json` records the source bytes. Exact filenames and native adaptations
are listed in `docs/metal-recipe-unlocks.md`. Native adaptations change only
recipe IDs and Horizon's recipe-unlocked predicate field.
